Pattern: Forcing the market template (KB/VX/FLOW, convergence matrix, TRADE.md) onto a non-market agent produces dead never-filled files.
Evidence: DARWIN — initialized 2026-02-18, one scan, went cold with empty market-shaped scaffold
Notes: Root cause of the meta-agent blueprint split. Meta/utility agents need a meta-shaped memory instead.

Pattern: Open-ended "watch the whole external landscape" mandates drift and go stale.
Evidence: DARWIN's arxiv/GitHub/HN weekly scan — abandoned after first pass
Notes: Scope external-evolution as an INPUT to a concrete artifact (the blueprint), not a standing patrol.

Pattern: A single maturity ladder mis-scores non-market agents — they lack convergence matrix / TRADE.md by design.
Evidence: NEXUS, TERRY, ORACLE, YEYOU have no market constructs yet are mature for their class
Notes: Per-class rubric (market/utility/meta) sharing an L0-L2 floor. See SPEC.md §5.

Pattern: Permission to edit another agent's files does NOT make it concurrency-safe — a live session clobbers the edit.
Evidence: Root Critical Rule #2; shared .git/index race history (incident 8ac5bf71)
Notes: Require BOTH approval AND idle-target before a cross-agent edit; live agents get task packets.

Pattern: Per-action approval prompts become operator-attention tax at scale.
Evidence: ORCHESTRATION_PLAYBOOK §2 relay discipline — dozens of idle pings flagged as pure tax
Notes: Batch structural fixes into one changelist for a single approval.

Pattern: Two files holding the same fact drift; classification + maturity must not both restate agent state.
Evidence: System cardinal rule (put facts in owner file, reference elsewhere); ROSTER vs FLEET_MAP risk
Notes: FLEET_MAP references ROSTER's active/dormant call; owns only maturity/design state.

Pattern: Missing a required section (e.g. BOTTOM LINE) is a conformance GAP, not a demotion to skeleton level.
Evidence: First scan v1 floored REGINALD (137 KB rows, L4-grade) to L0 for lacking a BOTTOM LINE heading
Notes: Caught in DAEDALUS's own scoring logic. Separate floor (presence) from conformance gaps (debt). Self-dogfood win.

Pattern: Has a structured record must be class-aware — meta/utility records are not market workbook/KB.tsv.
Evidence: Scan v1 floored DAEDALUS to L1 for lacking workbook/KB.tsv despite PATTERNS+FLEET_MAP
Notes: Count any populated top-level .tsv for non-market classes. Same per-class principle as PAT-003.

Pattern: STATUS-only grep misses discipline held in own-titled sections or moved to thesis/ subfiles.
Evidence: HENRY (HEN-NN triggers, 22 pred resolved) + CORAL (rails in thesis/THESIS.md) both flagged false-negative by grep
Notes: Script is a floor+flag generator; judgment must override grep-scope misses for L3+. Confirms SPEC.md §5 hybrid design.

Pattern: Fleet-wide single-section gaps (13 agents missing BOTTOM LINE) are batch-fixable, not per-agent work.
Evidence: First scan: 13/26 agents lack the required BOTTOM LINE
Notes: One changelist + one approval beats 13 task packets. The canonical DAEDALUS maintenance unit (PAT-005 batch principle applied).
